title: Operator radio check
procedure_text: Control initiates with: '<call sign>, this is Operator. Radio check. Over.' Field unit replies with readability and strength. Operator confirms with 'Roger' and next instruction.

title: Checkpoint Bravo arrival
procedure_text: When a field unit arrives at checkpoint Bravo, request perimeter status, signal quality, and next intended movement. If secure, hold for command approval before advancement.

title: Advance to checkpoint Charlie
procedure_text: Issue advancement only after Bravo is secure. Phrase: '<call sign>, Operator. Execute advancement to checkpoint Charlie. Acknowledge. Over.' Field unit should reply 'Wilco' before moving.

title: Relay hardline reset
procedure_text: Confirm unit identity, direct unit to isolate relay hardline, wait ten seconds, restore link, then report signal status. If link remains unstable, escalate to Control.

title: Construct anomaly triage
summary: Classify and contain a simulation anomaly
procedure_text: Log construct ID, affected sector, first observed timestamp, and impact level. For noncritical anomalies, continue observation. For critical anomalies, order units to hold position.

title: NATO phonetic readback
summary: Read back ambiguous identifiers with NATO phonetics
procedure_text: For noisy channel identifiers, read back using NATO phonetics. Example: 'Sierra 1, I read checkpoint Charlie, Charlie as in Charlie. Confirm. Over.'
